name: Grace "Baelfire" Parrish
biography: Grace Parrish (@BaelfireNightshd@infosec.exchange) is in her final year of a cybersecurity degree at Oregon State University. Grace has spent much of her career working with industrial control systems but has also dabbled in electrical engineering, FPGAs, microcontrollers, and a quick decade as a board level repair technician. In her spare time as a student, she has served as the team captain for a pentesting competition, has written custom Binary Ninja plugins, and has helped deliver hardware security training at Black Hat. Grace is looking forward to working in the offensive security space once she completes her degree.
